module_summary: Dual-clock asynchronous FIFO: binary write/read pointers address a dual_port_RAM child, Gray-coded pointers cross domains via two-flop synchronizers to derive full and empty.

anchors.name: winc
anchors.why: Write request; when not full advances write pointer and enables RAM write.

anchors.name: wdata
anchors.why: Write data passed directly to the dual_port_RAM write port.

anchors.name: wfull
anchors.why: Full flag from Gray pointer compare; blocks write pointer increment and RAM write.

anchors.name: rinc
anchors.why: Read request; when not empty advances read pointer and enables RAM read.

anchors.name: rdata
anchors.why: Read data output from the dual_port_RAM child.

anchors.name: rempty
anchors.why: Empty flag from Gray pointer compare; blocks read pointer increment and RAM read.

anchors.name: waddr_bin
anchors.why: Binary write pointer in wclk domain; low bits address RAM writes.

anchors.name: raddr_bin
anchors.why: Binary read pointer in rclk domain; low bits address RAM reads.

anchors.name: wptr
anchors.why: Registered Gray-coded write pointer sent across to the read domain.

anchors.name: rptr
anchors.why: Registered Gray-coded read pointer sent across to the write domain.

anchors.name: wptr_syn
anchors.why: Write pointer after two-flop rclk synchronizer, compared for empty.

anchors.name: rptr_syn
anchors.why: Read pointer after two-flop wclk synchronizer, compared for full.

anchors.name: wen
anchors.why: RAM write enable: winc gated by not full.

anchors.name: ren
anchors.why: RAM read enable: rinc gated by not empty.

groups.name: write_controller
groups.description: wclk-domain write pointer, Gray conversion, full detection and RAM write enable.

groups.name: read_controller
groups.description: rclk-domain read pointer, Gray conversion, empty detection and RAM read enable.

groups.name: pointer_synchronizers
groups.description: Two-flop synchronizers moving Gray pointers across clock domains.

groups.name: fifo_storage
groups.description: dual_port_RAM child storing FIFO entries, written on wclk and read on rclk.
